title: Mortal Kombat II
overview:
You've never experienced this level of Kombat! It's the ultimate arcade translation you've been waiting for! All the hidden arcade secrets! Eye-popping straight-from-the-arcade graphics! Pulse-pounding music and sound F/X! From "Finish Him" to "Flawless Victory," nothing, nothing can prepare you for the most spectacular Kombat of them all!

After Shang Tsung's defeat, the emperor Shao Kahn moves the Mortal Kombat tournament to his own realm of Outworld, and the thunder god Rayden leads Earth's warriors there to fight. Choose from twelve fighters, each with their own special moves, and battle through the tournament against the other warriors, the sorcerer Shang Tsung and the four-armed Kintaro before facing Shao Kahn himself.

- Win two rounds, then finish your dazed opponent with a Fatality, Babality or Friendship
- Two Fatalities per fighter plus stage-specific finishers
- A second player can jump in at any time to challenge you
- Five difficulty settings and adjustable credits
